full_judgment: Syed Md Dastagir Husain J : Rule was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the section 4 (খ) of ব্যাংক কোম্পানী (সংশোধন) আইন, ২০১৩ (Act No. XXVII of 2013) published in the Bangladesh Gazette on 22-7-2013 (Annexure-C) should not be declared to be void being ultra vires of the Constitution and as to why Report of the Credit Information Bureau classifying the petitioner as defaulter borrower and as to why debarring the petitioner from enjoying any kind of banking accommodation by applying sub-section 3 of section 27 KK of ব্যাংক কোম্পানী আইন 1991 should not be declared to have been made without lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
